summary.interpretation: Illustrative five-sample prompt-ranking check only. NOT a statistical generalization estimate. Misses cigarette in hand, so current threshold-free prompt ranking would cause a false negative.

model_loading_warning.observed: Checkpoint contains temperature and bias unused; SiglipModel logit_scale and logit_bias newly initialized.
model_loading_warning.implication: Absolute logits and margins not pretrained-calibrated. For a single image, exp(logit_scale)*normalized_dot_product + logit_bias is strictly order-preserving when finite, so missing scalar parameters do not fix relative prompt ordering and the hand false-negative on their own.
model_loading_warning.action: Any further SigLIP run must assert loaded pretrained encoder weights and either use normalized embedding cosine similarity with explicit no-calibration status or match scalar checkpoint keys only after checking exact architecture. Never treat logits or sigmoid as validated cigarette probability.
